clue.text: Detective's certain to accept appeal for offence

indicators.note: to accept means the outer letters take the appeal word into their middle

parts.note: DI is a Detective Inspector, so the possessive gives DI'S
certain means sure
an appeal is a plea

explanation.surface: A police officer insists on taking up a plea in a criminal case.
explanation.definitionFit: Taking offence is feeling annoyance, so the word is a synonym of being upset or vexed.

clue.text: Interesting order noticeable in columns originally

definitions.text: Interesting order noticeable in columns originally

indicators.note: originally points to the opening letter of each of the five preceding words

explanation.surface: An architectural style that catches the eye when looking at pillars.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both wordplay and definition: the initials spell the answer, and the clue as a whole describes the classical column style.
explanation.definitionFit: Ionic is one of the classical architectural orders, recognised by the scroll-shaped capitals on its columns.

clue.text: Plain couple that is welcoming affair, finally

indicators.note: welcoming means the other letters take a guest into their midst

parts.note: a couple is a pair

indicators.note: finally picks the closing letter of the word affair

parts.note: IE is the abbreviation of id est, that is

explanation.surface: Two plain-spoken people turn out to be hosting a romantic liaison at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: A plain is a broad flat grassland, and the North American grassland is the classic example.

clue.text: Life of priest in strange order

indicators.note: putting the letters in strange order means rearranging them

explanation.surface: A cleric's existence is unusually arranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Life in the sense of liveliness or spirit is a synonym, from the French word for spirit or wit.

clue.text: One helps to hush up a report

definitions.text: One helps to hush up a report

parts.words: One helps to hush up a report
parts.note: a report here is the bang of a gun, which a muffling device on the barrel quietens, while the surface suggests a cover-up

explanation.surface: Someone assists in suppressing an embarrassing document.
explanation.definitionFit: A gun's report is the noise of its firing, and a device fitted to the muzzle dampens that sound.

clue.text: Unusually precise instructions

indicators.note: unusually signals that the letters of precise come in an unusual order

explanation.surface: Directions that are remarkably exact.
explanation.definitionFit: Cooking directions for a dish are its method, so instructions is a loose synonym.

clue.text: Mistakenly marries best man losing one's shame

indicators.note: mistakenly signals that the letters are arranged wrongly

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I, and losing it means that letter is taken out of the pool

explanation.surface: A bride wrongly weds the groom's attendant and is mortified.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mistakenly' and 'losing' work together: the letters of MARRIES BEST MAN, less one I, are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Embarrassment is a feeling of awkward discomfort close to shame, so the two are synonyms.

clue.text: Revealing this compiler's style's primarily tricky

parts.note: the setter refers to themself, so this compiler is = I'M
style is mode, plus S for the 's

indicators.note: primarily picks the first letter of the word tricky

explanation.surface: The setter admits their approach is chiefly devious.
explanation.definitionFit: Revealing clothing shows a lot of skin, which is what an indecent outfit does.

clue.text: Unkind extraordinary rendition case

indicators.note: extraordinary means out of the ordinary, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Secretly moving a prisoner to be tortured abroad is a cruel business.
explanation.walkthrough: Extraordinary rendition is the transfer of suspects to foreign interrogation, so 'extraordinary' looks part of the phrase but is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Being thoughtless of others' feelings is a near synonym of being unkind.

clue.text: Method is reported to produce delicious food

indicators.note: is reported means the word is heard spoken rather than seen

parts.note: a method is a manner of doing something

explanation.surface: A cooking technique is said to create a tasty dish.
explanation.walkthrough: In a non-rhotic British accent the word for method sounds like the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: The food from heaven in Exodus is figuratively anything sweet or delightful to eat.

clue.text: Menial cop turns into officer

indicators.note: turns into means the letters change into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A lowly constable is promoted to a higher rank.
explanation.definitionFit: A police officer is the formal term for a constable on the beat.

clue.text: Nearly being in harmony squeezing old instrument

indicators.note: squeezing means the shortened word grips the next letter inside it
nearly means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: being in harmony is being according, as in agreeing

explanation.surface: Something almost tuneful squeezes an ancient musical instrument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Squeezing' also hints at how the instrument is played, with bellows pressed in and out.
explanation.definitionFit: A squeezebox with bellows and a keyboard is a musical instrument.

clue.text: Work over taking sexy snap

indicators.note: taking means the turned letters hold the next word
over means the work letters are turned round

parts.note: OP is short for opus, a work
hot means sexy

explanation.surface: A job involving a racy picture.
explanation.definitionFit: A snap is an informal word for a snapshot or picture taken with a camera.

clue.text: Carpeted perhaps, made of strong stuff?

definitions.meaning: a floor covered with rugs could whimsically be called this, carpeted being one example
tough and sturdy, as of someone hardy

explanation.definitionFit: Literally it means covered with mats; as an ordinary adjective it means sturdy and tough.

clue.text: Horses incapable of continuing race?

parts.note: race here means a line of descent, and castrated males cannot breed, while the surface suggests horses that cannot finish a race

explanation.surface: Racehorses that cannot complete the course.
explanation.definitionFit: These are castrated male horses, which cannot sire foals and so cannot continue the bloodline.

clue.text: Mugs inside stand mostly for judge again

indicators.note: inside means the fools go within the next word
mostly means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: a rest is a stand or support
a mug is a fool, as are asses

explanation.surface: Fools in the grandstand mostly giving another verdict.
explanation.definitionFit: To judge again is to evaluate once more, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Plant worker beginning to deploy garden tool

parts.note: a man is a worker, as in manpower

indicators.note: beginning to picks the first letter of deploy

parts.note: a rake is a garden tool

explanation.surface: A gardener starts using a tool in the garden.
explanation.definitionFit: The forked-rooted plant of legend, said to shriek when pulled up, is a member of the nightshade family.

clue.text: Who flogs beer on board? One on board

indicators.note: on, in the sense of aboard, means the beer goes inside the ship

parts.note: SS stands for steamship, so being on board puts letters inside it
ale is beer
a man is a piece on a chess or draughts board

explanation.surface: Someone sells beer aboard ship, and he too is aboard.
explanation.walkthrough: Flogs is British slang for sells, not beats; and 'board' is used twice, once for the ship and once for a games board.
explanation.definitionFit: Flogging is informal for selling, so someone who flogs is a seller.

clue.text: Small number clothing small honey

indicators.note: clothing means the outer letters wrap the inner word

parts.note: ten is a number
wee is Scottish for small

explanation.surface: A tiny quantity covers a little bit of honey.
explanation.definitionFit: To honey, as a verb, is to make sweet, as with sugar or flattering words.

clue.text: Kicked out of sack keeping excessively upset

indicators.note: keeping means the bed letters hold the next part

parts.note: the sack is slang for bed

indicators.note: upset in a down clue means turned upside down, so read backwards

parts.note: excessively means too

explanation.surface: Dismissed from a job and upset as a result.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sack' tempts as dismissal, matching 'Kicked out', but here it is slang for bed.
explanation.definitionFit: Being kicked out, as from a club, is being ejected, and kicking is done with the foot.

clue.text: Sort of art foundation almost inspiring amateur

indicators.note: inspiring, literally breathing in, means taking letters inside
almost means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: a foundation is an origin
AM is the abbreviation for amateur

explanation.surface: An art school's base nearly encourages a hobbyist.
explanation.definitionFit: The Japanese craft of paper folding is one particular kind of art.

clue.text: Strong garden tool holds

indicators.note: holds means the answer is contained within the following words

explanation.surface: A sturdy implement grips well.
explanation.definitionFit: A strong feeling is a passionate one, so fervent and strong are synonyms.

clue.text: Grass one found in jungle?

indicators.note: found in means the numeral is placed within the next word

parts.note: a jungle is a confusing tangle, like a labyrinth
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A single blade of grass discovered in the rainforest.
explanation.definitionFit: Corn is a cereal crop, and cereals belong botanically to the grass family.

clue.text: Weapon going wrong held by the German

indicators.note: held by means the error word sits inside the next word

parts.note: der is a German word for the
erring is going wrong

explanation.surface: A firearm malfunctions in the hands of a German.
explanation.definitionFit: A small pocket pistol named after its American maker is a weapon.

clue.text: Birds fancy heading south east

parts.note: fancy as an exclamation of surprise is gee

explanation.surface: Birds like to fly south-east.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fancy' is an exclamation of surprise here, not a liking.
explanation.definitionFit: These are waterfowl, a group of web-footed birds larger than ducks.

clue.text: Get round to eating bananas with sweetheart

indicators.note: bananas means crazy, so the letters go wild

parts.note: the heart of the word sweet is its middle letter

explanation.surface: Get round to eating fruit with one's darling.
explanation.definitionFit: To get round an obstacle is to manage to pass it, a sense of the word for steering around.

clue.text: Ready to get beer right before time

parts.note: ale is beer

explanation.surface: Prepared to get a drink just in time.
explanation.definitionFit: Being ready means prepared and watchful, so on guard is a synonym.

clue.text: Record single penned by hit Queen performer

parts.note: to enter is to record, as in a ledger

indicators.note: penned by means the numeral is enclosed by the next word

parts.note: to tan is to beat or hit
single is one, the Roman numeral I
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: A single record features in a chart hit by Queen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Record' and 'single' look like music terms, matching the band Queen, but work as enter and one.
explanation.definitionFit: A performer is anyone who amuses an audience, so the two words are synonyms.
